text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-2026-042 triggered at 1987654321 — High latency observed on /v1/generate (hosted). Symptoms: 5-30s tail latency, elevated error retries. Paging alex (on-call).

alex: I'm on it, joining bridge https://zoom.example/incident-INC2026042. Initial mitigations: reroute ~20% traffic to v1-small, disabled a KV-prefetcher. Seeing kernel OOMs on a subset of t4 hosts.

sara: Joining now. I'm attaching flamegraphs + traces to the incident doc: https://rwd.infra/incidents/INC-2026-042. Adding heap snapshots.

jamal: Support triage: 42 customers filed tickets in the window, 8 of those are paying with SLA. Will pull account IDs and timeline. Tentative affected window ~13:02–13:50 UTC.

morgan: Finance flag — please confirm impacted window and which customers are on hosted vs dedicated (dedicated excluded from hosted SLA). We need ASAP to start credit calc.

alex: Confirm hosted-only. Hotfix: rolled a restart on the t4-serving-pool at 13:50 UTC, KV reset cleared spike. Mitigation notes in infra ticket INFRA-2345.

sara: Hotfix worked; latency back to normal by 13:52. Postmortem required — we'll need timeline, RCA, and mitigation plan.

elaine: Customer PM note: one enterprise account reported downstream financial reporting delays. They asked for estimated credits. Please escalate to finance and CS.

incident-bot: Auto-note: scheduled on-call handoff at 14:30 UTC to jamal. Reaction :eyes:

jamal: Handoff accepted. I'll own the post-incident follow-up and coordinate credits sheet for finance.

alex: Creating action items now (tracking tickets attached):
- A1: Root cause analysis — alex (CORE-9876)
- A2: Autoscaler and batching config review — sara (INFRA-2345)
- A3: Customer impact + draft credit calc sheet — jamal (PM-7712)
- A4: Billing adjustment ticket and finance handoff — morgan (BIL-4421)

sara: Proposed postmortem time: 2026-05-04 16:00 UTC. Doodle for availability: https://doodle.example/pm-INC2026042. Owner: jamal.

morgan: Finance checklist: we use prorated credits against monthly subscription. Quick policy: outage >30m & <4h => 10% credit of monthly fee; >4h => 25%. Final calc needs account-level monthly fee and exact outage minutes. Please provide account list + subscription tiers.

jamal: I've started the spreadsheet here: https://sheets.example/INC-2026-042-credits. Columns: account_id, plan, monthly_fee, outage_minutes, calc_pct, credit_amt. Populating now, will tag finance when ready.

alex: RCA notes uploaded to incident doc. Early hypothesis: batching layer memory leak under specific request-size distribution, triggered a cascade when combined with prefetcher.

sara: Action item on autoscaler: reduce max batch size and add memory headroom check during scale-up. I'll create PR with config and schedule a canary rollout.

elaine: Please CC account execs and CS in any customer-facing credit communication. Legal review for the wording would be appreciated.

jamal: I'll draft the customer communication template and post it here for review before finance issues credits.

morgan: To open the billing ticket and provide a runnable sample for ops, use:
```
# create billing ticket
billing-cli create-ticket --queue "billing-adjust" --summary "INC-2026-042 credits" --body "outage 2026-05-04 13:02-13:50 UTC; see sheet: https://sheets.example/INC-2026-042-credits" --tags incident,credit
# sample apply command (finance will run after approvals)
billing-cli apply-credit --acct ACCT1234 --amount 1234.56 --reason "INC-2026-042"
```

morgan: I've created BIL-4421 and attached the basic policy and approval flow. Waiting on PM + CS approval to apply credits.

jamal: Postmortem outline I will produce: timeline, customer impact table, RCA, mitigations, owners+due dates. Will assign A1–A4 in the tracker and set SLAs for fixes.

finance-ops: BIL-4421 created and routed to billing approvers. Finance will compute provisional credit amounts once jamal fills the sheet and PM confirms outreach plan. We'll aim to include credits in next billing cycle upon approval.

alex: Quick note — added hotfix branch pkg/serving:fix-batching and linked PR for review.

incident-bot: Incident marked resolved and archived to /incidents/INC-2026-042. Postmortem scheduled; leave thread open for follow-ups. Reaction :white_check_mark:

finance-ops: FYI — once PM + CS sign-off, finance needs an explicit approval message in this thread ("PM approves credit amounts for BIL-4421") to trigger apply flow.

jamal: Will add final approvals here after PM/CS review. Assigning postmortem owner and due date 2026-05-11.

morgan: Thanks all — will monitor the sheet and queue credits after approvals.

elaine: Thanks team. Please keep me updated on customer comms draft before sending.
